designs.title: 硬核更新海报
designs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished Xiaohongshu promotional poster for the indie fan game PTCG Deck Agent version 0.6.0. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, preferably 1024x1536 or higher equivalent. High quality Chinese typography that is perfectly legible on a phone, exact copy below, generous safe margins, no cropped words. It is a fan game announcement, do not suggest this is an official Pokemon announcement, do not add official logos, trademarks as badges, fake QR codes, URLs, ratings, win rates, prices, release dates, or unsupported features. Illustrations are promotional art, do not invent a realistic game screenshot or readable fake trading card rules. Prioritize the headline and stunning art; limit text to the provided copy. Both facts must be present: all cards from the 30th anniversary expansion have been imported into this game, and players can download AI-ladder developer strategies and battle against those AI strategies. One single poster only, not a grid of multiple posters.
Style: bold premium sci-fi game HUD launch poster, near-black ink background with cyan illumination and a restrained bright yellow accent, sharp typography, layered translucent card silhouettes, dramatic arena lighting, strong editorial composition rather than crowded dashboard. Main visual: a dynamic fan of trading-card backs bursting through a luminous large 0.6.0, electric energy and precision HUD linework; no card-face texts. The two update points get clear small numbered callouts with substantial whitespace. Exact text: top brand "PTCG Deck Agent"; version badge "0.6.0"; enormous headline "新卡到齐\n强敌上线"; supporting lines "30周年补充包 · 全卡已导入" and "挑战 AI 天梯上的开发者策略"; bottom call to action "挑选策略 → 一键下载安装 → 开始对战". Chinese text is the most important element. A polished non-official game community launch key visual.

designs.title: 天梯挑战战书
designs.prompt: 制作一张中文小红书游戏宣传海报，1024×1536，2:3竖版。风格：现代平面电竞海报，橙红、洋红紫、黑色，强烈的对角线构图，丝网印刷颗粒，醒目的大字。只用原创几何卡背、阶梯、抽象光线作为插画，不画人物、角色、真实卡牌或游戏截图。视觉讲述玩家用自己的卡组挑战开发者编写的AI策略。版面清晰，字距舒适，中文必须准确，留足安全边距。只排以下文案：顶部“PTCG Deck Agent · 0.6.0”；大标题“天梯上的高手\n现在轮到你来挑战”；副标题“与 AI 天梯的开发者策略对战”；底部更新信息“30周年补充包全卡已导入”；行动提示“选一套策略，开一场对战”。这是一张独立游戏的社区宣传图，不加其他文案、数字或标志。

designs.title: 新手三步上手
designs.prompt: 制作一张精美的中文游戏新手指南宣传图，1024×1536，2:3竖版。风格：奶油黄底、钴蓝标题、薄荷绿点缀，友好、明快、大留白，柔软圆润的3D纸艺小物件。只用原创几何卡背、放大镜、下载箭头、抽象卡牌桌面，避免真实角色或界面。上方大标题，下方三步纵向路径，数字1、2、3十分醒目，每步有一个简洁小插画和大字号说明，所有字手机阅读清楚。准确排版以下文字，不添加文字：品牌“PTCG Deck Agent 0.6.0”；大标题“想练新卡？\n三步找到 AI 陪练”；第一步“发现 · 挑选天梯开发者策略”；第二步“下载 · 一键下载安装”；第三步“对战 · 用你的卡组挑战它”；底部醒目贴纸“30周年补充包\n全卡已导入”。这张图推广独立卡牌练习游戏中新卡和策略对战功能。
